When was Stephen Hunter Born? How old is Stephen Hunter?

Stephen Hunter was born on March 25th, 1946. Stephen Hunter is currently 80 years old.

Where was Stephen Hunter Born?

Stephen Hunter was born in Kansas City, Missouri, United States and is American.

What awards has Stephen Hunter won?

Stephen Hunter has won the following awards: Criticism at the Pulitzer Prize (2003).

What was the first book Stephen Hunter wrote?

The first book written by Stephen Hunter was The Master Sniper, published in 1980.

What was the most recent book Stephen Hunter wrote?

His most recently released work was The Gun Man Jackson Swagger on October 14th, 2025.

What genres does Stephen Hunter Write?

Stephen Hunter primarily writes in the Thriller genre. His work includes sub-genres such as Crime Thriller, Action Thriller, and Conspiracy Thriller.

How many books has Stephen Hunter written?

Stephen Hunter has written 36 books across 11 series.
  • 12 books in the Bob Lee Swagger Series
  • 4 books in the Earl Swagger Series
  • 1 Swagger Collection
  • 2 books in the Ray Cruz Series
  • 9 Standalone Novels
  • 2 Short Stories/Novellas
  • 3 Non-Fiction Books
  • 23 books in the Swaggerverse Series
  • 1 book in the Bibliomysteries Series
  • 1 book in the Mysterious Profiles Series

Is the novel Dirty White Boys part of the Bob Lee Swagger original trilogy?

No it is not, however it does take place in the same universe as it. It's advised that you read Dirty White Boys prior to Black Light as it is essentially a prequel to it.

What is the chronological order of Stephen Hunter novels?

You would read the Earl Swagger series first chronologically, meaning The Bullet Garden first. Then you would read the Bob Lee Swagger series, also reading the standalone novel Dirty White Boys prior to Black Light.
Also after Dead Zero, be sure to read Soft Target prior to The Third Bullet just for completeness. We have a complete listing of the chronological order of the "Swaggerverse" above.
